answer.rationale: Broadly roll out the proven shorter, simpler self-serve onboarding flow: it improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention, aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Do not counter the competitor with promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment increased signups and near-term qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, making it unsuitable as a sustainable response. Onboarding is not directly validated as a save tactic for already-churning price-sensitive accounts, so its impact on this acute churn spike remains uncertain.
